locator: Results 'LLMs improve on ontology-based ranking methods' paragraph 4
printed_value: In the case of ClinVar, we used the HPO phenotypes as input for ranking; these phenotypes are identical to the phenotypes associated with the causative gene in the database used by Exomiser, and this may bias the results.

AMELIE tends to have an upper hand in identifying targets for published cases (DDD dataset); after removing 156 HGMD (Pro-2021.2) included cases, the remaining 149 unpublished DDD cases showed an almost-unchanged overall trend, with slightly lower AMELIE performance in the top-20 experiment. The subset results are shown only in Supplementary Figure 2.

locator: Results 'Performance benchmarking for optimized prioritizers across different experiments' paragraph 1
printed_value: Exomiser under Protocol D, PhenIX under Protocol D, AMELIE under Protocol B and LIRICAL were compared as optimised settings; in DDD, Exomiser ranked the causal gene first in 61.6% and within the top 5 in 86.6% of 305 trio cases.
